concept: Premium Enterprise AI Dashboard with deep RTL support. Fuses the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype for extreme data clarity with Glassmorphism to convey a sense of modern AI intelligence. Eliminates generic 'Bootstrap' symmetry in favor of tension, dynamic spacing, and structural typography.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3, and major marketing callouts. Ensure tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) on sizes above text-3xl. NEVER use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for all dashboard data, chat messages, and UI controls. Provides a technical, authoritative tone suitable for enterprise.

typography.import_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports for Cabinet Grotesk (or similar geometric sans like Space Grotesk if Cabinet is unavailable, but prefer General Sans/Cabinet) and IBM Plex Sans in index.css.

rules: No generic gradients. Use flat, structural grayscale for surfaces.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use deep tinted indigo (#090A0F).
Primary CTA buttons must use the Electric primary color with high contrast text.
Glassmorphism surfaces should be highly saturated with 1px delicate borders.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (Nav/Chat Input): backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border border-border/50 shadow-sm
Dashboard Cards (Neumorphic Edge): Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-md and -translate-y-0.5
motion: Hover states must alter both background color and text color (e.g., hover:bg-primary hover:text-white).
Chat messages: stagger entrance animations slightly from bottom up.

layouts.general: Always use mobile-first responsive grids. Max-width containers for marketing, full-width (w-full) for dashboard.
layouts.landing_page: Use overlapping elements, large typography, and asymmetrical bento grids for features.
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid. Sidebar on the left (or right in RTL), main content area spanning the rest. Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.chat_interface: Main column (max-w-4xl) centered or side-by-side canvas if references are open. Input must be pinned to bottom using fixed or sticky positioning with glassmorphism to let scrolled text blur behind it.

rtl_guidelines.critical_instruction: The app requires a bilingual English/Arabic toggle. You MUST use logical CSS properties in Tailwind.
rules: Never use pl-, pr-, ml-, mr-, border-l, or border-r.
ALWAYS use ps- (padding-inline-start), pe- (padding-inline-end), ms-, me-, border-s, border-e.
Toggle mechanism: When language changes to AR, update document.documentElement.dir = 'rtl' and document.documentElement.lang = 'ar'. Tailwind handles the logical properties automatically.
Ensure icons (like back arrows) flip in RTL mode using rtl:-scale-x-100.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for landing page CTAs, sharp/subtle roundness (rounded-md) for dashboard. High contrast text.
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn components. Inputs must have clear focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).
component_guidelines.chat: Messages should NOT be generic chat bubbles. Render AI responses as transparent blocks with rich text formatting. User messages as subtle gray/tinted bubbles aligned to the end. Include 'Suggested Follow-ups' as small pill buttons.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use 'sonner' for all notifications. Position top-right (or top-left in RTL).

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, language toggles, chat submit) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='lang-toggle-btn').
accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for text. Active focus rings must be highly visible.

landing_hero_bg.description: Abstract blue glowing dots forming wave patterns, perfect for AI technology vibe.

dashboard_automations.description: Abstract orange lines, use as decorative background for automation workflow cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React.js application using .js/.jsx files (NO TypeScript .tsx files).
Setup language state context to manage EN/AR toggle globally.
Update tailwind.config.js to include Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans in the font families.
Override index.css base variables to match the colors defined in this guideline.
Implement the Chat Interface using a side-by-side canvas approach if source references are clicked, otherwise keep a centered max-w-4xl column.
Admin Dashboard must have a clear sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Knowledge, Employees, Settings, Automations).
Use lucide-react for all iconography. Apply strokeWidth={1.5} for a more refined look.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use Shadcn equivalents if possible, or build custom accessible dropdowns.
Ensure the entire app container does NOT have text-align: center applied globally (remove from App.css if present).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts or sloppy gradients. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Ensure all interactive components have proper hover/focus states and include data-testid. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays with content underneath.
